# judo-meta-measure

> An EMF/Ecore metamodel implementing the SI (International System of Units) standard for representing base measures, derived measures, units, and conversion rates within the JUDO model-driven ecosystem.

Key facts:
- Java 21 with Maven 3.9.4+ and Tycho 4.0.13 (Eclipse plugin builds)
- Multi-module Maven/Tycho project with 6 modules
- Core technologies: EMF/Ecore 2.38.0, Epsilon 2.8.0 (EVL validation), MWE2 2.13.0 (code generation)
- Dual packaging: Eclipse plugin (Tycho/P2) and standard OSGi bundle (Felix)
- Part of the [judo-community](https://github.com/BlackBeltTechnology/judo-community) ecosystem
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, metamodel description, module diagram, and quick start
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with build commands, directory structure, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, troubleshooting, and submission guidelines
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): CI/CD pipeline flows and branching strategy

## Modules — Core

- [model/model/measure.ecore](model/model/measure.ecore): Ecore metamodel definition — source of truth for all generated code
- [model/model/measure.genmodel](model/model/measure.genmodel): EMF code generation configuration
- [model/src/workflow/generateModel.mwe2](model/src/workflow/generateModel.mwe2): MWE2 workflow orchestrating the code generation pipeline
- [model/src/main/epsilon/validations/measure.evl](model/src/main/epsilon/validations/measure.evl): Epsilon validation rules for measure models

## Modules — Testing

- [model-test/pom.xml](model-test/pom.xml): JUnit 5 unit tests for model creation, XMI ID validation, and Epsilon constraint execution
- [osgi-itest/pom.xml](osgi-itest/pom.xml): Pax Exam integration tests deploying the bundle into a Karaf container

## Modules — Packaging

- [osgi/pom.xml](osgi/pom.xml): OSGi bundle repackaging with MeasureModelBundleTracker for auto-discovery of measure models
- [feature/feature.xml](feature/feature.xml): Eclipse feature descriptor for plugin installation via P2
- [site/pom.xml](site/pom.xml): P2 update site for Eclipse marketplace distribution
